subject: System Design
title: Reverse Proxies
description: Learn Reverse Proxies in one minute.

hook.text: Clients never talk directly to your servers. A reverse proxy sits in front, guarding and routing traffic.

buildup.text: NGINX and HAProxy accept client requests, apply security rules, and forward them to backend servers.

discovery.text: Reverse proxies handle SSL termination, compression, rate limiting, and request routing in one place.

twist.text: A misconfigured reverse proxy becomes a single point of failure for the entire system.

climax.text: Reverse proxies consolidate cross-cutting concerns so application servers focus only on business logic.

punchline.text: One gatekeeper for security, routing, and speed.

quiz.question: What does a reverse proxy do?
options: Sits in front of servers to route, secure, and optimize traffic
